SILT#00029: April 9th is CSS Naked Day. This sounds very salacious but all it means is removing CSS from your website and letting just the bare HTML stand out. JS is still on though. Came across it from Lume's documentation. Might be something I do next year. Link to the main page: https://css-naked-day.org/
